newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia merchandise imports rise in Nov.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia merchandise imports rise in Nov.

text.p: Australian merchandise imports rose one percent in November to A$6.400 billion seasonally adjusted from A$6.323 billion in October, the Australian Bureau of Statistics said.
This compares with seasonally adjusted imports of A$6.298 billion in November 1995.
In unadjusted terms, merchandise imports fell seven percent to A$6.640 billion in November from A$7.170 billion in October and compared to A$6.832 billion in November 1995.
Economists had on average forecast a rise of around 1.0 percent in seasonally adjusted imports for November.
The bureau said seasonally adjusted imports of consumption goods rose two percent in November, while capital goods rose six percent while intermediate and other goods fell one percent.
It said that in original terms, imports of consumption goods fell nine percent, with the largest decrease in transport equipment, mainly cars.
Capital goods imports included two aircraft worth a total A$95 million.
